title: FrameOS canvas-scoped undo history (no cross-canvas node injection)
defect: history snapshots carried no canvas identity and setBreadcrumb reset neither past nor future, so an action taken on canvas A could be undone on canvas B, injecting all of A's nodes/edges/groups into B. Measured: canvas B went from 0 nodes to 7 (all of canvas A's) after a single undo.
fix: HistoryEntry gained canvasKey written by pushHistorySnapshot; setBreadcrumb clears past/future on canvas switch; undo/redo reject and clear the stack when a snapshot's canvasKey does not match the current canvas (backstop)
